parts.name: Surface
parts.Basic_description: The surface of the clock is a flat circular glass cover that protects the clock hands and dial.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as a transparent protective layer, allowing visibility of the clock face while shielding it from dust and damage.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move during operation.

parts.name: Frame
parts.Basic_description: The frame of the clock is a circular aluminum structure that holds the surface and internal components together.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural support and aesthetic design, maintaining the integrity of the clock assembly.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and supports the other parts.

parts.name: Hand (Minute Hand)
parts.Basic_description: The minute hand is a slender steel pointer that indicates the minutes on the clock face.
parts.Functional_description: It rotates around the clock’s center to show the passage of minutes.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates continuously around the central axis driven by the clock mechanism.

parts.name: Hand (Hour Hand)
parts.Basic_description: The hour hand is a shorter steel pointer that indicates the hours on the clock face.
parts.Functional_description: It rotates around the clock’s center at a slower rate to display the current hour.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates slowly around the central axis, completing one revolution every 12 hours.
